userTweets.label: User posts
userTweets.description: API that fetches the list of posts by a given user.

userByScreenName.label: User info
userByScreenName.description: API that fetches a user profile (rest_id, bio, follower count, verification status, etc.) from a screen_name (@ID).

profileSpotlightsQuery.label: Profile spotlights
profileSpotlightsQuery.description: Believed to fetch supplementary information for the profile page, but the details are not public and unconfirmed.

voButtonEligibility.label: Vo Button eligibility
voButtonEligibility.description: Believed to determine whether a specific button (Vo Button) is shown, but the details are not public and unconfirmed.

flowViewer.label: Login flow
flowViewer.description: API that handles the progress of the login sequence (flow).

viewerContext.label: Viewer context
viewerContext.description: API that fetches context information for the logged-in user.

homeTimeline.label: Home timeline
homeTimeline.description: API that fetches the timeline of posts from followed users in algorithmic order.

homeLatestTimeline.label: Home timeline (latest)
homeLatestTimeline.description: API that fetches the timeline of posts from followed users in chronological order (newest first).

searchTimeline.label: Search
searchTimeline.description: API that fetches search results such as posts and users matching a search query.

followers.label: Followers list
followers.description: API that fetches the list of followers of a given user.

following.label: Following list
following.description: API that fetches the list of accounts a given user follows.

likes.label: Likes list
likes.description: API that fetches the list of posts a given user has liked.

createTweet.label: Post creation
createTweet.description: API that creates a new post.

deleteTweet.label: Post deletion
deleteTweet.description: API that deletes an existing post.

notificationsTimeline.label: Notifications
notificationsTimeline.description: API that fetches the list of notifications.
